tips.title: Mulch the soil
tips.detail: Cover soil with 5-8 cm of straw, leaves or crop residue. It cuts evaporation by up to 25-50% and keeps roots cooler.

tips.title: Switch to drip or sprinkler
tips.detail: Drip delivers water at the root and can save 30-50% water compared to flood irrigation while lifting yield. Check PMKSY (India) or your country's micro-irrigation subsidy.

tips.title: Irrigate early morning or evening
tips.detail: Less water is lost to evaporation and wind drift.

tips.title: Save water for critical stages
tips.detail: Give priority to flowering and grain/fruit filling; a lean irrigation earlier in the season is safer than missing these stages.

tips.title: Try SRI / alternate wetting and drying for rice
tips.detail: Keep fields moist rather than continuously flooded; alternate wetting and drying saves up to 25-30% water and cuts methane.

tips.title: Build a farm pond or check dam
tips.detail: Capture monsoon runoff for protective irrigation and recharge; many states subsidise farm ponds.

tips.title: Recharge groundwater in the rainy season
tips.detail: Direct excess runoff into recharge pits or trenches; it raises borewell levels for the dry months.

tips.title: Add compost to hold more water
tips.detail: Each 1% rise in soil organic matter helps the soil hold roughly 20,000+ litres more water per hectare.

tips.title: Contour bunds, ridges and furrows
tips.detail: Slow runoff and let water soak in on sloping land; use raised beds and drains where waterlogging is a risk.

tips.title: Choose drought-tolerant crops or varieties
tips.detail: Millets, pulses and short-duration varieties need 40-70% less water than rice or sugarcane and cope with El Nino dry spells.

tips.title: Irrigate by soil moisture, not by calendar
tips.detail: Push a finger 5-10 cm into soil: irrigate only if it feels dry. AgriN's soil-moisture and rainfall forecast will flag when to skip an irrigation.

tips.title: Keep weeds down
tips.detail: Weeds compete for water; timely weeding or mulching saves irrigation.

tips.title: Use solar pumps and reuse water
tips.detail: Solar pumps (PM-KUSUM in India) cut diesel cost; reuse treated household or dairy wash water for fodder or trees.

tips.title: Plant trees on bunds
tips.detail: Agroforestry lines reduce wind speed and evaporation, provide fodder, fruit and long-term income.

tips.title: Protect soil, biodiversity and energy
tips.detail: Reduce tillage, keep the soil covered, retain hedgerows for beneficial insects, use biogas from dung for cooking fuel and slurry as manure.
